summary: Frontend-only RBAC/Team UI verification on the LIVE preview (SAFE MODE). PASSED: owner 2-step login with no blank page / reload loop; owner sidebar shows all 10 nav items ENABLED (data-denied=false) incl. Payout wallets / Settings / Developers; company switcher for owner shows NO member role badge and an edit pencil per owned company; Settings->Team renders the new Activity panel (team-activity-panel, empty state then 1 row after the invite); /developer-keys label reads 'Settlement currency', changing USD->EUR opens settlement-currency-confirm-dialog with the correct copy, Cancel dismisses it and the currency STAYS USD (confirm button never clicked); Settings->Payments display-currency shows the 'View only' chip; member sees a 'Member' badge (company-role-1) and NO edit pencil for the granted business; when the granted business is selected, Dashboard+Transactions are enabled while Payment Links/Balances/Your page/Payout wallets/Settings are data-denied='true' with the tooltip "You don't have permission for this" and clicking a denied item does NOT navigate; sentinel member revoked and gone after reload (cleanup verified). BLOCKERS FOUND: invite acceptance is impossible in a real browser (CSRF 403) and a new teammate cannot log in through the UI (plus-addressed email not URL-encoded); member also defaults into an auto-created personal company and sees EMPTY dashboard/transaction data for the granted business.

critical.issue: 403 'CSRF token validation failed'. The invitee is unauthenticated (no Bearer, no dynopay_csrf cookie) and the frontend never sends x-csrf-token anywhere, but /api/team/accept is NOT in EXEMPT_PATHS in backend/middleware/csrfMiddleware.ts. Invite acceptance is 100% broken in the browser (backend log: '[CSRF] Blocked request to /api/team/accept'). Same risk applies to any other public POST added later.

Login step 1 says 'We couldn't find that email' for the newly created teammate. The frontend concatenates the raw email (pages/auth/login.tsx -> API_ENDPOINTS.user.checkEmail + email) so the '+' in dyno-rbac-uitest+<ts>@example.com decodes server-side to a SPACE and the lookup misses. POST /api/user/login with the same email works (200). Any user with a '+' in their address cannot get past the email step.

With the granted business ('The Dev Store', company_id=1) selected, the member with view_dashboard+view_transactions sees 'Make your first sale' / 'No transactions yet' / zero KPIs, while the owner sees $929.46 7-day volume and 658 transactions for the same company. Dashboard/transaction data appears scoped to user_id instead of company_id for non-owner members.

minor.issue: Revoking/removing a member does not create an activity row — Activity panel only logged 'Invited a team member'. Spec says activity covers write actions across the business.

ui_bugs.issue: Submitting the invite form shows the generic red 'Couldn't accept the invite.' with no hint; underlying cause is the 403 CSRF block. Needs the backend exemption (or a CSRF bootstrap) plus a real error message.

Accepting the invite auto-created a personal company for the invitee (company-option-97 'RBAC UITest', Individual) and that company becomes the DEFAULT selected workspace, so the member lands on their own blank onboarding dashboard ('Finish setting up', 'Add a payout wallet', 'Make your first sale') and the sidebar is fully UN-gated (0 denied) until they manually switch to the granted business. A user whose only real access is a granted business should default to that business and should not get an auto-created company.
Label reads 'Dashboard display currency' while the review spec expects 'Display currency' (the 'View only' chip itself is present and correct).
The currency <Select> has no data-testid (only aria-label='Settlement currency'), making the automated check brittle.

React console warning: validateDOMNesting(...)
cannot appear as a descendant of

(pre-existing).

integration_issues.issue: Cannot be completed by a real user: accept is CSRF-403'd, and even after accepting (via a test harness that supplies matching cookie+header) the member cannot pass the login email step because of the un-encoded '+' email.
Gating renders correctly but the permitted surfaces (Dashboard, Transactions) return no data for the granted company.

issues: 'Your first payment: 0% platform fee' onboarding banner and 'Make your first sale' empty state shown to a teammate of an established business — misleading copy for a member context

action_items: Add '/api/team/accept' (and review '/api/team/invite/' GET is fine) to EXEMPT_PATHS in backend/middleware/csrfMiddleware.ts, or bootstrap a CSRF token on public pages — invite acceptance is currently impossible.
URL-encode the email in the login email-existence check (encodeURIComponent) in pages/auth/login.tsx (both call sites, lines ~532 and ~1004); plus-addressed emails currently fail login step 1.

Do NOT auto-create a personal company when a user accepts a team invite, and default the selected workspace to the granted (is_member) company so members land in the right business with gating applied.
Scope dashboard/transaction queries by selected company_id for member users — member with view_dashboard/view_transactions currently sees an empty business.
Log revoke/remove (and other write actions) into the team activity feed.
Rename the display-currency label to 'Display currency' per spec and add data-testid to the settlement-currency Select.
critical_code_review_comments: csrfMiddleware EXEMPT_PATHS is a manually maintained allow-list while the frontend never sends x-csrf-token at all — every new public (unauthenticated) POST route will silently 403. Consider deriving the exemption from route metadata or documenting it in the router.
pages/auth/login.tsx builds query strings by string concatenation (checkEmail + email); use encodeURIComponent for every user-supplied query value.
Invite-accept path (backend team acceptInvite) creating a company for the invitee couples RBAC onboarding to merchant onboarding; membership-only users should have zero owned companies.

success_rate.frontend: 70% (7 of 8 review items fully pass; member invite/login path blocked, member data scoping wrong)

To exercise the member flow while the CSRF bug exists, use a page.evaluate harness: set document.cookie='dynopay_csrf=X' and send header x-csrf-token: X to POST /api/team/accept and /api/user/login, then localStorage.setItem('token', accessToken). Member gating only appears AFTER switching to company-option-1 (the granted business).
rca_of_the_issue: 1) CSRF: backend/middleware/csrfMiddleware.ts skips only GET/HEAD/OPTIONS, EXEMPT_PATHS, Bearer/x-api-key/x-publishable-key requests; the public invite-accept POST matches none of these and the frontend sends no x-csrf-token, so it always 403s. 2) Login email step: the email is appended to '/user/checkEmail?email=' unencoded, so '+' becomes a space server-side and userModel.findOne({email}) misses. 3) Member default workspace: accept-invite creates an owned company for the invitee which wins the default selection, so CompanyDataContext isMember=false and no gating is applied; the granted company must be preferred (or no company auto-created). 4) Member sees empty dashboard/transactions because those queries resolve data by the requesting user's own companies rather than the selected company_id.
